notable_absence.finding: No support-plan or billing-plan gate on scheduling, rescheduling, or cancelling a maintenance job - the only access-control axis is capella-role:* (Organization Owner or Project Owner). Also, like upgrade-database.json, zero cloud-provider-specific behavior anywhere on this page - the maintenance-job lifecycle (schedule, reschedule, cancel, preferred time) is described as uniform across AWS/Azure/GCP, in clear contrast to the backup/snapshot surface's heavy CSP-specific behavior found elsewhere in this batch.

cross_component_finding: This page is the authoritative source for the requiresCapellaRole gate this batch's other upgrade-related file (upgrade-database.json) lacked outright - together they show a clean split: upgrade-database.md documents the upgrade POLICY and notifies roles about it (notifiesRoleOn), while manage-maintenance.md documents the actual scheduling ACTION and gates it on capella-role:* (requiresCapellaRole). Also confirms Support-initiated mandatory maintenance jobs are NOT user-cancellable regardless of role ('You cannot cancel maintenance jobs scheduled by Capella Support... To cancel a support-initiated upgrade, Create a Support Ticket') - a support-mediated override of the otherwise role-based control, similar in shape to cloud/organizations/manage-organizations.json's finding that organization deletion is support-mediated rather than role-gated.
